sources.title: Falcon 40B
sources.snippet: Trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, Falcon 40B was the first home-grown open source, large language model (LLM) to be released with weights for research and commercial use. The model climbed to the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for Large Language Models within the week of its launch and gave the UAE a seat at the table among the world's most advanced AI nations ...

sources.title: GitHub - Decentralised-AI/falcon-40b
sources.snippet: Falcon-40B is a 40B parameters causal decoder-only model built by TII and trained on 1,000B tokens of RefinedWeb enhanced with curated corpora. It is made available under the TII Falcon LLM License. Paper coming soon 😊.

sources.title: Falcon 40B: Specs, Hardware & Live AI Battle | ModelVault
sources.snippet: Falcon 40B is a versatile open-weight language model developed by TII Falcon. Built on modern Transformer architecture with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), Falcon 40B delivers strong performance in instruction following, multi-turn dialogue, creative synthesis, and structured JSON output generation.
